resolution_notes: example.request: auditor correct. Official docs (https://apidocs.cheapshark.com/) Authorization/Rate Limiting section state: 'we do require sending a User-Agent on your incoming requests' and give e.g. MyApp/1.0 (contact@example.com). Original curl omitted the required header; corrected example adds -H 'User-Agent: MyApp/1.0 (contact@example.com)'.
